Name: Slimey Mayo
Author: cookietehcat
Description:
[b][u]Description:
[/u][/b]Adds the ability to turn all variants of slime eggs into mayonnaise! While they increase the base value, they will also come with [b]powerful effects that stack with your food[/b]! Hopefully this'll make slime farming a bit more interesting and exciting for you.

Included is a config option to disable the eyes as I've noticed some find it disturbing... However, SlimeyMayo Corp. has since responded to these allegations, going on record to assure they're not real eyes, just branding on the container itself. Slime lovers, rejoice! No slimes were harmed in the making of this mod.*

[size=1]*Harm to slime eggs excluded.[/size]

[u]Effects and Pricing:[/u]
The current balancing on this mod is subject to change based on player feedback. An important thing to note is that I decided to categorize them as Monster Loot, as I found that artisan price increases made the profits a liiiittle too ridiculous in my opinion, but if enough people think otherwise I'll be happy to change it. I'm also looking to gauge if the effects of drinking the mayo are too powerful or too weak considering the trade-off of profit loss and the power of them being a drink and thus stackable with other buffs.

[u]Green Slime Mayo:
[/u]Price: 1,500
Effects:
+2 Farming
+2 Foraging
Duration: 11:40

[u]Blue Slime Mayo:
[/u]Price: 2,625
Effects:
+2 Defense
+2 Mining
Duration: 11:40

[u]Red Slime Mayo
[/u]Price: 3,750
Effects:
+2 Speed
+3 Attack
Duration: 11:40

[u]Purple Slime Mayo
[/u]Price: 7,500
Effects:
+2 Luck
+32 Magnetism
Duration: 11:40

[u]Tiger Slime Mayo
[/u]Price: 10500
Effects:
+1 Luck
+2 Speed
+2 Attack
Duration: 11:40

[b][u]Installation:
[/u][/b]1. Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Download the zip for Slimey Mayo.
4. Extract it to your mods folder.
5. Launch the game through smapi and enjoy!
